create_bm25_miner: create a BM25_Miner instance to index documents from msmarco or bright datasets for retrieval
search_bm25_index: search the BM25 index with a query string and get top 1000 document scores
select_hard_negatives: select hard negative documents for a query by skipping top results and avoiding the gold document
load_ms_marco_documents: load and chunk MS MARCO v1.1 training documents into 2000-word passages with query IDs
load_bright_documents: load BRIGHT dataset documents or long context documents for a specified task
